description: Train a Gaussian scene from posed RGB and an initial point cloud
commands: uv run physicalview run reconstruction --config configs/local.yaml --scene room --scene-dir data/scannetpp/data/room --out data/splats/room.ply -- --init-ply data/scannetpp/data/room/init_points.ply --iters 15000
inputs: Calibrated scene contract and initial colored point cloud
outputs: Inria-format Gaussian PLY and training report. Holdout RGB metrics are separate from capture quality.
